verdict.rationale: Each skill ships its own SKILL.md describing what it does (review, qa, ship, office-hours, autoplan, cso, upgrade, learn, skillify), and docs/skills.md catalogs skills with roles and behavior. Activation conditions are documented in places: voice trigger phrases for /qa, per-host injection of domain skills, a router skill that dispatches requests, and the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE check. missing for 10: activation/trigger conditions shown for only a few skills rather than every one, background behaviors like end-of-session learning are only partly covered, no independent or hands-on corroboration that the docs predict agent behavior.
